- Numerous abilities and power ups available to the player
- Wide variery of dinstinct obstacles and enemies
- Miniboss battles at the end of each stage
- 2 player mode, in which players can take turns at any time during gameplay
- 4-digit password system for saving progress

214852.overview:
This ROM hack completely replaces all of the original NES graphics with those of the Arcade game.  The game is totally revamped, all characters, sprites, backgrounds, the intro and cutscenes, everything was remade to look like the arcade, and it’s amazing!  Practically nothing is preserved from the original title, and that’s a good thing.

Months have passed since the release of this hack. And strangely enough, it has gone relatively unnoticed. And it is important to emphasize “strangely” because it is a masterpiece.

A notable improvement has also been made in the playable area by removing the battery bar (which decreases as time passes). This doesn’t really change the difficulty of the game, but it makes it less frustrating by not feeling the constant time pressure.

215543.overview: Retroplayer.nl Championship 2015 is a competition cartridge similar to Nintendo World Championship 1990 where the player compete in three games for a combined total score. This game was successfully Kickstarted in 2015 for the use in the Retroplayer.nl forum competition. The three games on the cartridge are modified versions of Chip & Dale: Rescue Rangers 2, ExciteBike, and Tetris.

216313.overview:
You just got fired from Walmart!!! Pesky bastards! They MUST get REKT!!!

But do you have what it takes to get to Walmart's HQ and show them who really is going to get REKT? Avoid the security guards, REKT the Rollback Smiley, and get through dangerous warehouses full of sharks, gun turrets and smileys in order to get to your managers' places and getting them absolutely REKT. However, your managers might have some nasty surprises up their sleeves! Are you up to the challenge of getting the world's top supermarket chain REKT... Or will you be the one getting REKT?

216913.overview:
You start your journey as a hero in Golden Forest and your task is to go through the world slaying enemies, collecting items and helping humans in quests. 

There are :
- More than 70 rooms to go through
- 4 worlds ( Golden Forest , Frosty Mountains, The Boneyard and Raven's Gate )
- Items and weapons  to equip
- A lot of enemies to slay
- 3 quests to complete
- Shops to buy items from

218983.overview:
Rockman 4 - Burst Chaser X Air Sliding is a romhack that combines two unique concepts from 2 different Rockman hacks. Burst Chaser, where Rockman moves fast with farther jumping distance. And Air Sliding, where Rockman can slide in mid-air.

Rockman 4 BCAS also features new music, level designs & modified enemy & Robot Master AIs, as well as new weapons.

219718.overview:
THE SCUM OF THE CITY HAVE MET THEIR MATCH!
The city runs rampant with Pushers, Pimps and Perverts and it's up to you to clean up the streets. You must train at Master Rikki's Dojo to perfect your skills and stop the corrupt New World Government before it's too late! Based on the popular independent film from Award-winning filmmaker Dustin Ferguson ("Nemesis 5″).

417991.overview:
A Mario Party Board is cursed by one of Bowser’s sons! Defeat him in order to save the day!

A spooky old hack that makes use of the SMB3 disassembly to do more than what’s normally possible!

-Use your new BOMB power up to take aim! Holding up or down will allow you to target higher or lower creatures!
-Three special new powers, two only found in the bonus level!
-Be the Princess, and kick butt!

418212.overview: Are you Rad enough to help Reggie and his pal Sakura to free the galaxy from the grip of the bastardly dictator El Gato Blanco?  This radical game is based on the Ninja Jajamaru series that was originally released on Famicom.  Battle Bodacious Bosses.  Play Alone or with a Friend. Use over a Half-Dozen Radjitsu Skills.

421317.overview: No other baseball game gets you closer to playing in the big time than R.B.I. Baseball. Because every one of the ten teams in R.B.I. Baseball contains the rosters and player stats officially licensed from the MLB Players Association. Like real baseball, these skills and stats affect the outcome of every play. Like a real manager, you'll need to make good use of this vital information - and wise strategy decisions - if you want a winning record. R.B.I. Baseball is so intensely realistic, we've added amusing animation and a touch of humor to keep the action light-hearted and fun. You can play against the computer in a nine game season or compete against a friend in your own best-of-seven series. Stop playing with no-names and step up to the plate with real superstars in R.B.I. Baseball!

421546.overview:
A simple puzzle game.

Dpad:  Move
A:  Push
B:  Retry

421681.overview:
Rockman 6: Unique Harassment is a romhack of Mega Man 6 by Tatsu. It is the third detailed Mega Man 6 Rom Hack after Rockman 6: Spirits of Hackers and Rockman 6: Innocent. Instead of facing the 8 Robot Masters from the World Competition, Mega Man will square off against many Robot Masters from his long history. Will Mega Man be able to defeat them all again?

Features:

New levels
Features Robot Masters (and other enemy robots) from other Rockman games
New Robot Master attack patters
New Weapons
“New” BGM
Weapon and Adaptor switch function

423992.overview:
“Ranma Saotome, a young fighter must face his worst rival … his own shadow! After a failed training, it kidnaps Akane and takes over Furinkan High School. You do not have much time. Hurry up, save Akane!”

On his 5th anniversary as a romhacker, the author of this hack gives a deep facelift to one of his first projects, renaming it Ranma vs. Ranma!

424192.overview: John Rambo is removed from prison by his former superior, Colonel Samuel Troutman, for a top-secret operation to bring back POW’s still held in Vietnam. Rambo’s assignment is to only take pictures of where the POWs are being held, but Rambo wants to get the POWs out of Vietnam. Teamed up with female Vietnamese freedom fighter Co Bao, Rambo embarks on a mission to rescue the POWs, who are being held by sadistic Vietnamese Captain Vinh and his Russian comrade, Lieutenant Colonel Padovsky. Rambo starts killing every enemy in sight while still focusing on his intentions to rescue the POWs. There are also corrupt American officials involved in the mission, including Marshall Murdock, one of Rambo’s superiors.

424253.overview: Roniu's Tale is a top down puzzler with action elements. While levels are designed to have one or more path, each step Roniu takes will cause the tiles to break as he passes. Using magic and a little thought, it's up to you to help Roniu locate the orbs and keys he needs to find his way out.

424261.overview:
Drive your RC car through the circuit and try to finish as fast as possible!

-This is a time attack game in which you control an RC car and drive it on a circuit.
-You can change the settings of the RC car.
-The circuit is automatically generated by setting a 4-digit number (random string).
-You can compete with your friends by sharing the random string.

424263.overview:
Cheri has lost her family in the battle of the holy realms, now she travels to the lost realm of souls outside the kingdom of Reknum to revive her loved ones. Along the way, she will learn to use the Magic Sword and will equip herself with new gadgets. Will you be able to help her achieve her mission?

With a labyrinthine overworld from aerial perspective and connected dungeons in lateral perspective, you will enjoy classic platforms full of action and exploration. Solve puzzles, unlock new weapons, new thematic areas, face threatening bosses, and more in this magic-filled game for the NES Reknum Souls Adventure!

424497.overview: Rockman 2: Basic Master is a complete level hack of Rockman 2 for the NES. New music, new (and old) enemies, different boss behaviors, and more.

424499.overview: Rockman Deus Ex Machina is one of the best sophisticated hacks in Mega Man II history. It is programmed almost every part of the game you’ve never expected before. The boss fights are incredibly hyperactive. Players find this hack a clear winner. Background Music is made by the author of Rockman No Constancy IKA. Additional patches were added by Misty in the Japanese 2ch boards about August 8th such as Hard Body and Weapon Modification. A must play for all expert Mega Man II players. Not newbies.

447507.overview: Rockman 4 Sparking to Hero is a ROM hack of the classic NES game Rockman 4 (Mega Man 4). It is a well-done hack that changes all the levels up to the third Dr. Wily stage, enemy patterns, and stage graphics. The hack is designed to be a fun and challenging experience for fans of the Mega Man series.

451233.overview:
A baby's gotta do what a baby's gotta do!
Everyone's favorite babies are back in action! When Tommy, Chuckie, Phil, and Lil see a commercial for the new Reptar video game, they pretend that they're in a video game of their own! Through the power of imagination, the babies transform Tommy's house into a video game world full of action, excitement, and adventure!

451693.overview:
Here is a homebrew release which offers the similar game-play of Rampart but instead of shooting cannons you are vandalizing your neighbors property.  Build your house out of wall templates, buy furniture, and then break into your opponent's house across the road to steal furniture. Keep your house the better looking of the two to win.
Released in Double Action 53 compilation cart.

451728.overview: ‘Roidz is a graphical re-tooling of the original Metroid, in similar fashion to MDbTroid, but with it’s own style and aesthetic. This hack features all new sprites and updated background graphics, new animations, and a couple of other small treats that help breath new life into this classic game.

453473.overview: Pack for Mega Man hacks from 1 to 6 of the NES with Proto Man as main character instead of Mega Man, mainly for the following hacks mentioned below: Proto Man: The Red Bomber (Mega Man), Mega Man 2: Proto Man Mode, Break Man III (Mega Man 3), Proto Man IV (Mega Man 4), Mega Man 5: Proto Man Edition and Proto Man VI (Mega Man 6). Some of these hacks are popular, others are not.

453497.overview: Here is a conversion patch which converts the graphics in Magic Dragon and also changes some of the music in the game as well.

453520.overview:
In the high-stakes world of special operations, the powerful and covert Rescue Force unit is tasked with executing near-impossible missions with unmatched precision. In a desperate bid to save a captive comrades, the unit's esteemed commander handpicks a skilled soldier to penetrate four heavily fortified enemy bases. Engulfed in a lethal dance of evading enemy onslaughts, navigating treacherous terrains studded with tanks and other devilish traps, the soldier's unwavering determination will be the pivotal factor in successfully executing this thrilling rescue operation.

This game is a top down shooter, much like Metal Gear. Although, the controls are much tighter, and the action stays continuous, making for a better all around experience.

453529.overview: After damaging an Indonesian Artifact while visiting Indonesia, Dr. Wily goes back to his lab and makes something new.

456785.overview: Adds 2nd player functionality to NES Double Dragon.

456859.overview: The world’s favorite Rag Dolly comes to your Nintendo system in an exciting and challenging video game adventure. Join beloved children’s characters Raggedy Ann and Andy and their friends for twelve stages of fun. Take on pirates and monsters on the high seas. Explore the frozen ice caves of Looney Land. Travel through the sky to take on the voracious Greedy. Battle King Koo Koo in the haunted forest. Venture into the mysterious and maze-like hidden castle. But watch out! General D, the personification of death and destruction, has clouded everything with darkness. You’ll need to rescue your friends, and even fight some of them until they come to their senses. It’s a magical adventure you won’t soon forget!

459232.overview: In pixel 52, 40 of your monitor lives Bleeki, who works to make sure that the correct color is displayed by that pixel. To accomplish his task, he must push boxes known as colorbits into the correct areas. In this NES game, your objective is to help Bleeki do his job across 12 stages. As long as there's a tile below him or next to him to stand on, you can move him in any direction to swap his position with one of the colorbits'. But be careful: don't let them crush you! As long as you keep moving, the colorbits won't fall.

459235.overview: Do you have what it takes to get rid of every box blocking the Maze of Anctrayl? In this NES sequel to Anctrayl, the Game Boy Snake-Sokoban hybrid, your goal is to push these boxes into the goals spread across the stages. Putting a box on a goal turns it into a piece of wall - yet another obstacle to avoid - and makes your energy trail longer. There are 10 levels in total, but the game loops and gets faster once before the ending can be seen.

459611.overview: Your goal is to conquer the randomly generated dungeon and find the sacred Relic.

459660.overview:
Rockman 5: Double Jumper is a hack that features a new skill for Rockman, the Double Jumper (press the jump button on mid-air to perform it, like Forte and Zero).

The hack also features:
 - New level designs
 - New boss move patterns
 - New weapons behavior

459779.overview:
This game is a love letter to early arcade platformers.

The player controls a rocket-powered-motorcycle, along with it's passengers.

Help them get home safe without exploding or falling into the abyss.

459797.overview: You are a snake that is really hungry. You must chase the rodents down and eat them, but be careful not to bite yourself.

460615.overview: Rolling Hare is a simple platformer game where you play as a Hare who likes to roll alot. You must collect all carrots in different worlds!

460616.overview: The Rolling Hare is back! You must plow through different levels to collect all carrots!

462615.overview:
This is an HD pack for the NES game Road Fighter, exclusively for use with the Mesen NES emulator. It upgrades the quality of many sprites in the game.

An upgraded version titled Road Fighter: Enhanced was released by LiQuiDz, which included:

* New Start Screen
* All Cars Replaced
* Bonus Cash/Gaz car is now Green with flashing headlight
* When there is an oil spill near, the hazard light on the red car start to flash
* Animated Speed and Gaz Gauge
* Updated Side Animation
* Fixed Missing Sprites
* Cheat Code Detection

467148.overview: R-Type is a game that set the standards for side scrolling shooters. It had a unique force weapon that could attach and detach from your ship, serve as a second blaster on the screen, and could also be used as a shield to protect your ship from oncoming attacks. It also had intense alien boss battles where your ship would take on an enemies the size of the screen. This awesome game had ports made for several different consoles, but somehow never made its way over to the NES. What we got instead is a Japanese clone called Magic Dragon. Although Magic Dragon is a blatant ripoff of R-Type, the graphics were horrible in comparison. The ship was an ugly yellow, and the enemies were nothing more than genetic robots. This hack changes all of  that, and turns Magic Dragon into the game it was trying to copy, R-Type. The R-9 ship was added back in place of the awful yellow one. All graphics, enemies, and bosses were changed as well.

468788.overview: Here is a complete hack for the Rock Man 3 ROM. All the music, levels, and stage graphics have been changed. Also some of the enemies AI has been altered also. Please note that sliding is closer to 4 or 5 specifications now. Also weapons can be changed via using the select button and done backwards by holding down and pressing select.

468889.overview:
Rockman Cross X is a hack for Rockman 5: Blues no Wana (not the overseas version, Mega Man 5) that changes the game into a boss-rush type with very little focus on platforming. All the bosses have been rewritten, giving each one new attacks not seen yet.

This hack is playable up to the second fortress stage, and features a good number of secret weapons and bosses. You may also enter a pure boss-rush where every boss is confronted in a random order by pressing Select on the title screen.

468891.overview: MegaMari is a hack of the JP version of Megaman called Rockman. The hack changes the level design, palette, and graphics. It is a parody of a Megaman-inspired game for PC called MegaMari. Info on the PC game can be found here.

471029.overview: Here is a complete hack for Rockman 5. All the stages have been edited, some new graphics, and the entire game has new music. Also included is an interesting feature you can do. You can now slide not just on the ground but in mid-air, as well! In addition to the main patch are 2 patches that you can apply alone to a Rockman 5 ROM if you just want the Air Sliding ability only. This is intended for Rockman 5. Please be aware of risk if you apply to a Mega Man V ROM.

478379.overview: This is an unofficial pirate RPG based on SNK's King of Fighters series. The game follows the storyline of King of Fighters '94, '95, and '96.

478380.overview: This is an unofficial pirate RPG based off of SNK's King of Fighters series, and a direct sequel to Nanjing's earlier game Quan Huang R1. The game picks up where the previous game left off and covers the events of King of Fighters '97.

480040.overview:
THE STORE IS CLOSED. THE NET IS UP. THE CLOCK IS RUNNING.

Twelve minutes of hockey on a tar-and-gravel roof in New Jersey -- and the only
thing between you and the net is a co-worker who has never once done his job
and isn't about to start now.

Skate the puck out of the corner. Line up the mouth of the net. Shoot before
Randal gets goal-side and leans on you, because up here there is no goalie, no
referee, and no second chance off the boards.

Play it out. Somebody has to win the roof.

BUT NOBODY GETS TO FINISH.

FEATURES
- **1 OR 2 PLAYERS!** Hand pad 2 to a friend and settle it properly
- **A FULL 12-MINUTE PERIOD** on a single-screen rooftop rink
- **NO GOALIE. NO REF. NO MERCY.** Poke checks, body checks and shots off the
  brick
- **SHOT-ONLY SCORING** — you can't walk it in, you have to bury it
- **AN ENDING YOU CAN'T ARGUE WITH**

480941.overview: Backport of the PC game Richman 2, a board game similar to Monopoly.

482147.overview: The case is open. The trail is cold. Only one cat has the claws for the job. Rip is a detective with nine lives and a nose for trouble. When a Demon dog goes missing under mysterious circumstances, Rip prowls through dangerous streets, shadowy trains, and twisted hideouts to sniff out the truth. Every level brings new clues and new dangers. Will Rip uncover the truth?
